نستصلح (form X)
# نَسْتَصْلِحُ (nastaṣliḥu) /nas.tasˤ.li.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْلَحَ (istaṣlaḥa)
# نَسْتَصْلِحَ (nastaṣliḥa) /nas.tasˤ.li.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْلَحَ (istaṣlaḥa)
# نَسْتَصْلِحْ (nastaṣliḥ) /nas.tasˤ.liħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَصْلَحَ (istaṣlaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
